m: अनु-√ धा to add in placing upon, Lāṭy.; to stimulate to, RV. vi, 36, 2; to concede, allow, (Pass. aor. -धायि), RV. vi, 20, 2.
1. अनु-√ 1. धाव् to run after, run up to; to follow; to pursue.
a: अनुधाव् — {c1c} P. 1 To run after; follow; ऋषीणां पुनराद्यानां वाचमर्थोऽ नुधावति U. 1. 10 the sense follows the words (the words being not uttered with a view to a particular sense); स्वरुचिं निश्चयतोऽनुधावति Śi. 16. 44 follows his own will. --2 To run up to, approach. --3 To cleanse, wash.

s: klI, (anu + DAv + BAve lyuw .) paScAdDAvanaM । anusanDAnaM । yaTA, -- “tasmin kuraNgaSAvAkzI muhuScittaM nivAraya । na tanmanastavADInaM vfTA tatrAnuDAvanaM” ॥ ityudBawaH ॥
v: na॰ anu + DAva--lyuw । paScAdgamane, tattvaniScayAyAnusaraRe, anusanDAne ca ।
m: 1. अनु-धावन n. chasing, pursuing, running after
close pursuit of any object, going after a mistress.
a: अनुधावनं — 1 Going or running after, following, pursuing; तुरग ˚कंडितसंधेः Ś. 2. --2 Close pursuit of an object (for the knowledge of truth); research, investigation. --3 Seeking a mistress, though unattainable. --4 Cleansing, purification.

m: अनु-धावित mfn. pursued, run after (literally or figuratively).
अनु-√ धी (p. Ā. -दीध्यान; impf. P. 3. pl. -दीधियुः) to think of RV. iii, 4, 7 and x, 40, 10; AV.
अनु-धूपित mfn. (√ धूप्), puffed up, proud, RV. ii, 30, 10.
अनु-√ धम् (3. pl. धमन्त्य् अनु) to sprinkle over, RV. viii, 7, 16.
अनु-√ धन्व् (perf. Ā. 3. sg. -दधन्वे) to run near, RV. ii, 5, 3.
अनु-√ धे Caus. -धापयति, to cause to suck, to put to the breast, ŚBr. xiv.
अनु-√ ध्वंस् Ā. (perf. -दध्वसे) to fall or drop upon, TS.

v: strI anu + DyE--aN । SuBAnucintane, anugrahe, AsaktO ca ।
a: अनुध्या — [ध्यै-अङ्] Thinking or wishing well of, favouring, attachment.

v: na॰ anu + DyE--lyuw । anukzaRacintane “yA naH prItirvirUpAkza! tvadanuDyAnasamBaveti” kumA॰ ।
m: अनु-ध्यान n. meditation, religious contemplation, solicitude.
a: अनुध्यान — p. p. Mused, thought of &c. --तं --नं [ध्यै-ल्युट्] 1 Thought; अनुध्यानानंतरमेव K. 262; meditation, religious contemplation. --2 Thinking of, remembrance; या नः प्रीतिर्विरूपाक्ष त्वदनुध्यानसंभवा Ku. 6. 21. --3 Wishing well of, affectionate solicitude for; अनुध्यातैरुपेतव्यं वत्सयोर्भद्रमस्तु वः U. 7. 11; सा त्वमंब स्नुषायामरुंधतीव सीतायां शिवानुध्यानपरा भव U. 1.

v: pu॰ anu + DyE--karttari GaY । anucintake SuBAnucintake । “bAlasyASaktasya vA tadanuDyAyamanaseti” prA॰ ta॰ smftiH ।
a: अनुध्यायः — [ध्यै कर्तरि घञ्] One who wishes well of.

m: अनु-√ ध्यै to consider attentively, think of, muse; to miss, Kāṭh.; to bear a grudge, TS.
a: अनुध्यै — {c1c} P. 1 To think of, muse, consider attentively. --2 To wish well of, to bless, favour; प्रजानिषेकं मयि वर्तमानं सूनोरनुध्यायत चेतसेति R. 14. 60 bless; अनुदध्युरनुध्येयं सांनिध्यैः प्रतिमागतैः 17. 36 favoured.

v: tri॰ anu + DyE--karmmaRi yat । anugrAhye yadIyaSuBAnucintanaM kriyate tasmin । “anudaDyuranuDyeyaM sAnniDyEH pratimAgatEriti” raGuH ।
a: अनुध्येय — a. To be favoured or wished well of; अनुदध्युरनुध्येयं R. 17. 36.
